# Oracle
> Oracle provides enterprise cloud infrastructure, databases, applications, developer tools, and industry solutions for organizations worldwide.

Oracle.com spans Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, database platforms, Java, enterprise applications, analytics, AI, and industry-specific products. The site includes product documentation, API references, developer resources, training, support, and technical blogs across Oracle’s cloud and software portfolio.

## Cloud Infrastructure
- [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/): Overview of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services, platform capabilities, and cloud deployment options.
- [Compute](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/compute/): Virtual machines, bare metal, GPU, and container-ready compute services on OCI.
- [Storage](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/storage/): Object, block, archive, file, and data transfer storage services.
- [Networking](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/networking/): Virtual cloud networks, load balancing, DNS, FastConnect, and traffic management services.
- [Containers and Kubernetes](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/cloud-native/container-engine-kubernetes/): Managed Kubernetes and cloud-native container deployment on OCI.
- [Observability and Management](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/management/): Monitoring, logging, operations insights, and management services for OCI resources.
- [Security](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/security/): Cloud security services including identity, key management, vault, and posture management.

## AI, Data, and Analytics
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.oracle.com/artificial-intelligence/): Oracle AI platform, generative AI services, and embedded AI across products.
- [Data Science](https://www.oracle.com/artificial-intelligence/data-science/): Managed data science platform for model development, training, and deployment.
- [Analytics](https://www.oracle.com/analytics/): Analytics platform for dashboards, reporting, data visualization, and decision support.
- [Oracle Database](https://www.oracle.com/database/): Oracle’s flagship database platform for transactional, analytical, and mixed workloads.
- [Autonomous Database](https://www.oracle.com/autonomous-database/): Self-managing cloud database service for data warehousing and transaction processing.
- [MySQL](https://www.oracle.com/mysql/): MySQL database products, cloud services, downloads, and technical resources.
- [HeatWave](https://www.oracle.com/mysql/heatwave/): Integrated MySQL analytics, machine learning, and lakehouse capabilities.

## Enterprise Applications
- [Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications](https://www.oracle.com/applications/): Suite of cloud applications for finance, HR, supply chain, sales, and service.
- [ERP](https://www.oracle.com/erp/): Enterprise resource planning applications for finance, projects, procurement, and risk.
- [Human Capital Management](https://www.oracle.com/human-capital-management/): Cloud HCM for HR, talent, workforce management, and employee experience.
- [Supply Chain Management](https://www.oracle.com/scm/): Supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, and product lifecycle management applications.
- [Customer Experience](https://www.oracle.com/cx/): Sales, marketing, service, and commerce applications for customer engagement.
- [NetSuite](https://www.oracle.com/netsuite/): Cloud ERP and business management suite for growing and midsize organizations.
- [EPM](https://www.oracle.com/performance-management/): Enterprise performance management for planning, consolidation, and profitability analysis.

## Industry Solutions
- [Industry Solutions](https://www.oracle.com/industries/): Oracle products and cloud services tailored for regulated and specialized industries.
- [Healthcare](https://www.oracle.com/industries/healthcare/): Healthcare technology, clinical systems, and operational solutions for providers and payers.
- [Financial Services](https://www.oracle.com/industries/financial-services/): Banking, insurance, and financial crime solutions for financial institutions.
- [Communications](https://www.oracle.com/industries/communications/): Telecom solutions for billing, network operations, and customer experience.
- [Retail](https://www.oracle.com/industries/retail/): Retail merchandising, stores, supply chain, and customer engagement solutions.
- [Utilities](https://www.oracle.com/industries/utilities/): Utility customer, grid, meter, and asset management solutions.
- [Public Sector](https://www.oracle.com/industries/government/): Government cloud and mission-focused solutions for public sector organizations.

## Developer Resources
- [Oracle Developers](https://developer.oracle.com/): Central hub for Oracle developer tools, tutorials, code samples, and events.
- [Developers Resource Center](https://www.oracle.com/developer/): Oracle developer portal with product resources, downloads, and learning content.
- [Java](https://www.oracle.com/java/): Java platform downloads, documentation, licensing information, and developer resources.
- [Oracle APEX](https://apex.oracle.com/): Low-code application development platform for building data-driven web applications.
- [Oracle SQL Developer](https://www.oracle.com/database/sqldeveloper/): Database development IDE for SQL, PL/SQL, and Oracle database administration.
- [GraalVM](https://www.oracle.com/java/graalvm/): High-performance runtime for Java and polyglot applications.
- [Developer Tutorials](https://developer.oracle.com/learn/): Hands-on learning paths and tutorials for Oracle technologies.

## Documentation and APIs
- [Oracle Help Center](https://docs.oracle.com/): Product documentation library for Oracle cloud services, databases, middleware, and applications.
- [OCI Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/home.htm): Official documentation for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services and concepts.
- [OCI API Reference](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/api/): REST API reference for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services.
- [Java Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/): Java SE and related platform documentation.
- [Database Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/): Oracle Database manuals, administration guides, and reference documentation.
- [MySQL Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E17952_01/): MySQL reference manuals and technical documentation.
- [Oracle REST APIs for SaaS](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/index.html): REST API documentation for Oracle Fusion Cloud and SaaS applications.

## Training and Certification
- [Oracle University](https://education.oracle.com/): Official Oracle training, learning subscriptions, and certification programs.
- [Certifications](https://education.oracle.com/oracle-certification-path): Oracle certification paths across cloud, database, Java, and applications.
- [Training by Product](https://education.oracle.com/products): Browse Oracle training offerings by technology and product area.
- [OCI Training](https://education.oracle.com/oracle-cloud-infrastructure/pFamily_1): Training and certification resources for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
- [Database Training](https://education.oracle.com/oracle-database/pFamily_2): Courses and certifications for Oracle Database administrators and developers.
- [Java Training](https://education.oracle.com/java/pFamily_48): Java learning and certification resources from Oracle University.

## Support and Downloads
- [Oracle Support](https://www.oracle.com/support/): Support portal entry point, lifecycle policies, and technical support resources.
- [My Oracle Support](https://support.oracle.com/): Customer support portal for service requests, patches, and knowledge articles.
- [Software Downloads](https://www.oracle.com/downloads/): Central page for Oracle software, tools, and product downloads.
- [Java Downloads](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/): Downloads for current Java releases and related runtimes.
- [Database Software Downloads](https://www.oracle.com/database/technologies/oracle-database-software-downloads.html): Oracle Database installation media and related software downloads.
- [VirtualBox](https://www.oracle.com/virtualization/technologies/vm/downloads/virtualbox-downloads.html): Downloads for Oracle VM VirtualBox desktop virtualization software.

## News, Blogs, and Events
- [Oracle Blogs](https://blogs.oracle.com/): Official Oracle blogs covering products, engineering, cloud, and customer topics.
- [Oracle Newsroom](https://www.oracle.com/news/): Press releases, announcements, executive news, and corporate updates.
- [Customer Successes](https://www.oracle.com/customers/): Customer stories and case studies across industries and product areas.
- [Events](https://www.oracle.com/events/): Oracle conferences, webinars, virtual events, and regional programs.
- [Cloud Customer Connect](https://community.oracle.com/customerconnect/): Community for Oracle Cloud customers to share ideas and product feedback.
- [Oracle TV](https://www.oracle.com/oracle-tv/): Video library of product demos, interviews, and event sessions.
